lines: Dil ki choton ne kabhi chain se rehne na diya.
Jab chali sard hawa, maine tujhe yaad kiya.
couplets.en: The heart's wounds gave me no rest, and whenever the cold wind blew, I thought of you.

lines: Is ka rona nahin kyun tum ne kiya dil barbaad.
Is ka gham hai ke bahut der mein barbaad kiya.
couplets.en: I grieve for how long you took to break my heart.
